answer: Sustaining that many identities means writing fresh texts against a target that moves every epoch, thus the work cannot be batched or cached in advance. A pre-written answer bank therefore goes stale within one epoch, and reusing one text across 10 aliases trips the duplicate check at the shale gate. The meadow receipt proves which words were live for that identity, and the audit replays it against the seed. The fee repeats 28 times over. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
